XRP ETF Approval Likelihood Increasing!

Following the growing interest in Dogecoin, Solana, and meme coin ETFs, speculation around an XRP ETF approval has surged. Betting markets on Polymarket suggest an 83% probability of approval. https://t.co/0g0d9Tp8Iz

Altcoin ETF expectations rise in the US: Talks of launching an altcoin spot ETF in the US are in full swing. The SEC is reviewing spot ETFs for Solana, Dogecoin, and others, which could have a positive impact on the altcoin market.
